The Offered Light

A few chosen words. A place to rest them.
A light someone can return to, with nothing
asked in return.

01 · Material & light

Warmth, without weight.

Limestone · ivory · forest ink · sage · brass
Matte paper, glazed ceramic, translucent wax.

02 · A considered voice

Human at every scale.

A little peace.
A name held gently.

Georgia for dedications. Clear sans for controls.
Long names wrap; the scene expands with them.

Water · 1,200 msRipples begin at the touch and dissolve.
Sound · by choiceSilent arrival. Soft attack, fading release.
Reduced motionA still glow; immediate state changes.
